coefficient_index_binding: New orbit reuses the same 91 coefficient points and generator permutations; run.py asserts exact equality to coefficient_points91.txt before using the 364 flat and 756 nonflat plane maps.
whole_classes: Frobenius-stable Btw has five fixed points plus five pairs. F3-defined plane embeddings commute with Frobenius, so actual folded distinct pins have size 10+s. run.py derives pins from actual fold labels and checks current degree/cardinality; remaining anchor cap is Delta-len(pins).
full_current_coverage: cover.cpp parses all n vertices/all m edges of the chosen current source and runs one multisource closed depth-4 traversal. Its missing list is over 0..n-1, including all augmentation vertices. The core_missing count in run.py is only a diagnostic. All old edges are copied unchanged for a hit; a guarded hit gets another selected-set full-current R4 check.
observations_sent_to_producer: prepare.py seed_matrix_F9 metadata differs from the actual explicit R used by ../run.py and ../orbit.json. Numerical pool reads the correct saved orbit; metadata should be corrected without changing or rerunning pool data.

The existing native prepare searches for a single guard even at anchor_cap=0. For mandatory-missing 12-pin items, the adapter must classify no remaining guard budget rather than accept that guard or assert if one is returned. This is a changed-interface capacity case, not a new coverage computation.
scope: Only changed adapter and cache interfaces; no duplicate source validation or producer numeric run.
